title: A team of personal assistants
sub: A request or a routine's own tick reaches a supervising agent; a scope check decides what a partner has to see.

steps.h: A request arrives; a routine's tick is the other way in
steps.d:
"Reschedule Thursday's 2pm with Larsen and follow up
on the overdue invoice." The invoicing assistant's
weekly pass reaches the same handoff with nobody asking.

steps.h: The chief-of-staff agent hands off the scheduling half
steps.d: → scheduling assistant: reschedule Thursday 2pm, client Larsen

steps.h: It hands off the invoicing half in the same turn
steps.d: → invoicing assistant: follow up, invoice #214, client Larsen

steps.h: The scheduling assistant checks memory and drafts
steps.d:
memory: Larsen reschedules to Friday mornings when possible.
draft: propose Friday 10am.

steps.h: The invoicing assistant checks memory and drafts
steps.d:
memory: Larsen disputed a charge last quarter.
draft: polite follow-up, dispute flagged in the note.

steps.h: The scope check clears the reschedule automatically
steps.d:
reschedule, no dispute history on this thread: routine.
Sent without a pause.

steps.h: The scope check holds the invoice follow-up
steps.d:
touches billing on an account with an open dispute
in memory: held for the partner, not sent automatically.

steps.h: The partner reviews and sends it
steps.d:
sees: the draft, the reason held, the dispute note.
edits one line, approves.
